q: In which year was Sheffield United founded at Bramall Lane?
hint: Sheffield United Cricket Club set up a football branch at its ground in March 1889 to replace the gate money it had lost.

q: Sheffield United have played their home matches at the same ground since the club was formed. Which one?
hint: Bramall Lane was already a cricket ground when the football club was created there, and United have never had another home.

q: Which shirt design has been Sheffield United's first choice for most of the club's history?
hint: Red and white stripes with black shorts have been the Blades' colours almost from the beginning.

q: In which season did Sheffield United win the Football League First Division title?
hint: Ernest 'Nudger' Needham captained Sheffield United to the championship in 1897-98, the club's only top-flight title.

q: How many times did Sheffield United win the FA Cup before the Premier League was formed in 1992?
hint: United lifted the cup in 1899, 1902, 1915 and 1925, and have not reached a final since 1936.

q: Tony Currie left Sheffield United in 1976 after eight years at Bramall Lane. Which club signed him?
hint: Leeds paid £250,000 for Currie in 1976, a record fee for them at the time; he moved on to QPR three years later.

q: Which club's departure from Bramall Lane in 1887 led the ground's owners to start their own football team?
hint: Wednesday were tenants at Bramall Lane from 1881 to 1887 and walked out after a row over rent, costing the cricket club its biggest earner.

q: Bramall Lane staged the world's first football match played under floodlights. In which year?
hint: On 14 October 1878, four 30-foot wooden towers lit an exhibition match at Bramall Lane, eleven years before the football club existed.
